neighbours.label: Explicit multiplicity of parts or ingredients within a whole.
fire: The medicine acts on multiple parts of the nervous system.
This sauce contains a short list of recognizable ingredients.
The toy has three sides covered with bright paint.
The supplement combines several ingredients in one tablet.
The disease can damage multiple organs at the same time.
The recipe uses a number of different ingredients from the pantry.
The building contains twelve storeys of offices.
The project brought together specialists from multiple disciplines.
quiet: The medicine acts on a single part of the nervous system.
This sauce contains one recognizable ingredient.
The toy has one side covered with bright paint.
The supplement contains one ingredient in each tablet.
The disease can damage one organ at a time.
The recipe uses one ingredient from the pantry.
The building contains a single floor of offices.
The project brought together specialists from one discipline.

notes: Card links sides, ingredients, spanning and multiple. Exploratory multiplicity examples separated but were below the required median amplitude; this broader hypothesis may fail. Controls retain the object and replace multiplicity with a single constituent. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory sentences are disjoint from this preregistered test.
